core_obligations: The author approximates a measurable Bernoulli independent set by finite clopen cylinder data and transports that finite combinatorial pattern through a Borel coloring of a free action. The resulting uniformly covering Borel independent-set family yields the fractional chromatic bound and the exact Bernoulli-shift identity.
